items.statement: Within the explicitly defined ideal-slab model, Pt substitution moderates H2 binding and facilitates HMF reorientation relative to Ni111.
items.expected: The direction is independently inferred from the submitted energy comparison and supported by validated barriers.

items.statement: The conclusion is limited to the idealized electronic-energy slab model and should not be generalized directly to MFI-supported experimental selectivity or kinetics.
items.expected: The report states model and convergence limitations and separates energetic evidence from catalytic performance claims.
